AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation *is* construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (exoskeleton.py:47-49). SHARED-FINDINGS section 2's shared verdict, copied: the game runs these from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom via CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded (CombatManager.cs:860-867) inside StartCombatInternal (CombatManager.cs:394-398), i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart (CombatManager.cs:403); the sim runs them at create_monsters (combat.py:134), before relics attach (combat.py:157-159), before belt potions register (combat.py:164-166), before the parity Niche HP roll (combat.py:152-153) and before hooks.on_combat_start (combat.py:208). Same observable today on all three of section 2's clauses (listener set / HP-roll inversion / roll ordering); executed for this unit by `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py rocket-ctor`, which prints the listener set at monster-construction time for a two-monster hive encounter: ['CombatHistory','StrikeCard','DefendCard', the previously-created monster's own powers] - no relic, no potion. Rule 7: the rationale leans on sts2_rl/combat.py, sts2_rl/relics/ruined_helmet.py, sts2_rl/relics/unsettling_lamp.py and src/Core/Combat/CombatManager.cs, which this record does NOT hash. Amount matches: Exoskeleton.cs:49 applies HardToKillPower 9m to itself.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: The one unit in this batch with BOTH branch classes, and both are read correctly. C# (Exoskeleton.cs:52-75): RandomBranchState 'RAND' takes AddBranch(SKITTER, MoveRepeatType.CannotRepeat, 1f) and AddBranch(MANDIBLES, CannotRepeat, 1f) - overload #6 in the seam's step-13 table (R repeatType, Func<float> weight after the float promotion), so NO integer argument is present and there is nothing to misread. The sim writes add_branch(skitter, 1.0, MoveRepeatType.CANNOT_REPEAT) / add_branch(mandibles, 1.0, CANNOT_REPEAT) (exoskeleton.py:62-63) - weight in positional slot 2, repeat type in slot 3, which is exactly right for this overload. Executed: `py audit/tools/state_machine_probes.py mismatch` prints this pair as a MATCH (SKITTER w=1.0 CANNOT_REPEAT max=0 cd=0; MANDIBLES ditto), so exoskeleton is NOT a sixth G1 monster. ConditionalBranchState 'INIT_MOVE' adds four states in the order first/second/third/fourth -> SKITTER/MANDIBLES/ENRAGE/RAND; the sim adds the same four in the same order (exoskeleton.py:65-68), which matters because ConditionalBranchState.GetNextState returns the FIRST branch whose predicate is true (seam step 26). Follow-ups SKITTER->RAND, MANDIBLES->ENRAGE, ENRAGE->RAND and the registration order [INIT, RAND, SKITTER, MANDIBLES, ENRAGE] both match, and initialState is the conditional branch on both sides.

guards.what: slot names and per-encounter slot count
guards.rationale: ExoskeletonsNormal.cs:20 Slots = [first, second, third, fourth] and :29-36 generates four Exoskeletons in that slot order; ExoskeletonsWeak.cs:14 Slots = [first, second, third] with three. ExoskeletonsEncounter (exoskeleton.py:88-104) uses _SLOTS = (first, second, third, fourth)[:count] with count 3 (weak) / 4 (normal). The C# predicate reads Creature.SlotName; the sim reads self.slot, set by the same encounter. Consequence checked: in the WEAK encounter no monster can take the 'fourth' arm, so RAND is only ever reached as a follow-up there - true on both sides.

SkitterDamage 1 (literal, Exoskeleton.cs:34) x SkitterRepeats (DeadlyEnemies, 4, 3) -> 3; MandiblesDamage (DeadlyEnemies, 9, 8) -> 8; EnrageMove applies StrengthPower 2m (:99). Sim _SKITTER_DMG=1, _SKITTER_HITS=3, _MANDIBLES_DMG=8, _ENRAGE_STR=2.

With two branches both CannotRepeat, RandomBranchState.GetStateWeight (seam step 19) zeroes whichever move is the last log entry, so RAND strictly alternates once it has been entered twice in a row; the sim's _effective_weight (state_machine.py:201-204) reproduces that. Note the alternation is NOT total: MANDIBLES routes through ENRAGE, so the log between two RAND visits can be MANDIBLES, ENRAGE - both sides then allow MANDIBLES again because the last logged move is ENRAGE.
